Visit note | 2025-08-09 12:30 PM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Shafiq Khan, 64, male. Mr. Khan reports experiencing vomiting, belly cramps, and loose watery stools. He states that these symptoms began after a picnic in Kushtia. He works as a homemaker. He has no known comorbidities. On examination, his pulse is 98 bpm, with other vitals showing BP 111/75 mmHg and weight 80 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild generalized tenderness, and bowel sounds are hyperactive. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat rice, bananas, and toast, and wash hands before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.
